name: web

scripts.//build: The budget runs as part of the build, not as a separate check, so exceeding it fails the build rather than producing a report nobody opens.
scripts.//lint: src and e2e both, or a spec can reach a commit with an unused import while `pnpm lint` reports clean.
scripts.//test:a11y: The accessibility gate. Separate from test:e2e because it has to be runnable on its own in seconds during design work, while the E2E suite grows through phases 07 to 12 and will not be.
scripts.//test:visual: Baselines are committed, so a regeneration is a reviewable diff. Use `test:visual:update` deliberately and read the resulting images before committing them.

//dependencies: lucide-react is a direct dependency rather than something re-exported by @cera/ui. Icon takes a LucideIcon rather than an icon name, so this app imports the two dozen glyphs it uses and the other 3,676 are never bundled - re-exporting them from the design system would defeat that.
//devDependencies: axe-core is a direct devDependency even though @axe-core/playwright depends on it, because the spec support code imports its `Result` type. Relying on a transitive install would make the build depend on the hoisting layout rather than on a declared dependency.
